name: NocoDB
description: Turn a database into a spreadsheet you can share, an Airtable alternative

paths.name: Data
paths.description: The SQLite database with your tables, users and settings (including the sign-in key NocoDB makes on first start), and uploaded files. Back it up.

ports.name: Web UI
ports.description: NocoDB web UI and API, published on host as 6765

variables.name: TZ
variables.description: Your time zone, like Europe/London or America/New_York.

variables.name: NC_DISABLE_TELE
variables.description: true stops NocoDB from sending anonymous usage numbers to its makers. Set it to false to send them.
